name: ZX_AR_TAX_COND_LINES_ALL
description: The AR_TAX_CONDITION_LINES_ALL table stores the expression lines that define a tax condition. Each expression line can reference fields of a taxable transaction, including ship-to, ship-from, and bill-to information. Each tax condition can be grouped with prior conditions with and/or clauses. . The primary keys for this table are TAX_CONDITION_LINE_ID, TAX_CONDITION_ID, and DISPLAY_ORDER.

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier, used to identify the expression line record for each line within a tax condition

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_ID
columns.description: Part of the primary key, identifies the tax condition that this condition line belongs to

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: DISPLAY_ORDER
columns.description: Part of the primary key, controls the display order of each tax code used within a tax group

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_CLAUSE
columns.description: Controls how different conditions for a tax code can be used. Values include AND, OR, ELSE.

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_ENTITY
columns.description: Identifies which entity that this tax code is conditional on. Values include SHIP TO, SHIP FROM, BILL TO.

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_OPERATOR
columns.description: The evaluation operator. For example, =, >, or <>

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_FIELD
columns.description: Used to name the field within the entity that this tax code is conditional on (for example, Country, County, State, Province, FOB, Tax Classification, or City)

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_VALUE
columns.description: Character value string

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_EXPR
columns.description: Compiled expression

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.
